test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming the information given in the statements is true, even if they appear to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All pears are melons.

All melons are apricots.

All apricots are fruits.

**Conclusions:**

1. All pears are fruits.

2. Some fruits are melons.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f8250723d43f52ba1db96589a3ce628b07fd14bb4c999439773cf6acd9acbe2.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All pears are fruits → Follow (As all pears are melons, all melons are apricots and all apricots are fruits. As whole pears comes in melons which whole comes in apricots which whole comes in fruits, therefore it is true)

2. Some fruits are melons → Follow (As all melons are apricots and all apricots are fruits. As whole melons comes in apricots which whole comes in fruits, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions 1 and 2 follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
